# pip install -U the packages in pyproject.toml in a test venv, run the tests, then copy `pip freeze --exclude pip`
# and run `python scripts/hash_requirements.py` (PyPI's SHA-256 of every file per version; installs use
# --require-hashes, so a changed or substituted file is refused).
